prompt: Night on the teak afterdeck of a private yacht, 1920s, seen from knee height through a wide lens. A heavy, jolly white banker of 60, clean-shaven, round red cheeks, double chin resting above an open wing collar, white dinner jacket, stands three-quarter to us with his face taking up a third of the frame, mouth open on a big happy note. Far behind him over black water a wooden motor launch burns, small, its fire doubled on the swell. A sea-green deck lantern lights his face and mouth; the fire rims his shoulder orange. Full frame, no bars. Thanks.
